free_fit.title: Rotclimate Free-Fit Atlas
free_fit.eyebrow: Climate, farming and settlement · three layouts · c.200 AD
free_fit.lede: Explore the climate, food potential and settlement scenarios. Choose a map topic, then a layer; select a place for its climate and farming details.
free_fit.note: World and physics fitted to your painted seasonal zones, with the structures adopted on Earth r30–r36 available to the fit. Climate averages surroundings layouts 1–3, with recorded linear, temperature and moisture convergence checks. Farming and population layers use low-input c.200 AD technology; population values are declared settlement scenarios.

earth_physics.title: Rotclimate Earth-Physics Atlas
earth_physics.eyebrow: Simulated climate · 25 seasonal steps · physics that also reproduces real Earth climates
earth_physics.lede: Click anywhere on land to see its climate through the local year, and which real places feel most alike.
earth_physics.note: Physics fitted on six real regions (California, Iberia, south-east US, Levant, Central Asia, East China) and only allowed to drift slightly while matching your map; reversed spin. It gets the Mediterranean band right but cannot make the painted cold-dry north dry.

whittaker_fit.title: Rotclimate Whittaker-Fit Atlas
whittaker_fit.eyebrow: Climate, farming and settlement · three layouts · c.200 AD
whittaker_fit.lede: Explore the climate, food potential and settlement scenarios. Choose a map topic, then a layer; select a place for its climate and farming details.
whittaker_fit.note: Fitted to the strict target-to-Whittaker crosswalk with a diagram-coverage guard, with the structures adopted on Earth r30–r35 available to the fit. 1.44% of source land remains outside the unchanged envelopes (8.52% before the guard). Annual biomes do not guarantee summer drought or swamp hydrology. Climate averages surroundings layouts 1–3, with recorded linear, temperature and moisture convergence checks. Farming and population use low-input c.200 AD scenarios.
